description.value: Kirin Seafood Restaurant is a long-established fine Cantonese seafood and dim sum restaurant that has been a fixture of Richmond's culinary scene since 1987, operating under world-class chefs with roots in Hong Kong's celebrated 'New Era' cuisine movement. The Richmond location sits in Three West Centre at Westminster Highway and No. 3 Road, offering elaborate menus featuring whole abalone, lobster, and dim sum alongside banquet and wedding services. For touring cyclists exploring Richmond, it represents a notable opportunity to experience high-end Cantonese cooking in one of Canada's most acclaimed Chinese-food destinations.
